features.quote: Infinite Loop Detection: If the model repeats the exact same action + error 3 times consecutively, force-stop the run.
Surrender: Model outputs a specific phrase (e.g., "I cannot solve this," "I am giving up") or apologizes profusely and stops calling tools.
Run 1 task of each type on GPT-4o and Qwen-7B to calibrate the turn limit (ensure it's long enough to see rattling but not too long to waste money).
features.justification_quote: long enough to see rattling but not too long to waste money
